item.title: Victorian pubs to stay open until 3am under Labor election promise
item.description: The government is promising to extend opening hours for the state's pubs and change the Food Act so that dogs will be allowed inside venues at the publican's discretion. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Migrant doctors filling GP gaps where 'there's nobody else'
item.description: As political debate about slashing migrant numbers continues, a medical centre in the NSW Southern Highlands is relying on doctors from overseas. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: V'landys steps down as Racing NSW boss to secure firmer grip on NRL
item.description: Peter V'landys moves one step closer to becoming the NRL's executive chairman after stepping down from Racing NSW. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Tories target universal credit claimants in plan condemned as ‘fast track to poverty’
item.description: Proposals aim to push people into work, but charities say families are still paying price of austerity cuts and rise in cost of living People claiming universal credit (UC) would have their payments cut by a third if they have not paid enough national insurance, under a Conservative plan condemned by one charity as “a fast track to increased poverty”. Under the proposals, those who receive this “subsistence allowance” would have it paid into a dedicated debit card that would prevent from them buying alcohol or tobacco, based on an Australian system that was scrapped after trials found limited… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Live: 'Bond market riot' sends Wall St lower, ASX to follow
item.description: The Aussie share market is set to fall as the price of oil surges above $US100 a barrel. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Bindi Raye lives the ultimate FIFO lifestyle online. None of it is real
item.description: Bindi Raye's online profiles portray the life of a twenty-something-year-old FIFO worker in WA's north, but an ABC investigation has found she does not exist. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: An OpenAI agent accessed public and private data after hacking into a Medicare data portal in June. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: First Nations workers in Australia paid 16pc less per hour, report finds
item.description: A landmark report has found Indigenous workers are on average paid 16 per cent less an hour than the average Australian, amounting to nearly two months of work each year for free. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Why this beach was named Sydney's cleanest
item.description: This spot on the city's northern beaches has been named the cleanest, while another popular Sydney beach is given a "poor" rating for the fifth year running. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Cheeky' 95yo celebrates another birthday jumping out of a plane
item.description: Betty Gregory moved into aged care just weeks before turning 95. But that didn't stop her from skydiving to celebrate her birthday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: OpenAI agent hacked Medicare portal, PM says
item.description: Anthony Albanese says he has spoken to the Open AI chief executive to express his concern about the incident and the length of time it took the tech company to inform the government of the breach. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Anomalies' in images could prompt further search for young Gus Lamont
item.description: Seasoned senior officers are not in the habit of being publicly unrestrained in their feelings, but a moment of emotion from the chief detective investigating the disappearance of four-year-old Gus Lamont has underlined the commitment and determination of police. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Missing mum likely had frequent phone contact with Cairns man
item.description: A coroner has heard Joanne Butterfield's telephone bill showed nine calls to another landline in the lead up to her 1998 disappearance but detectives did not speak with the man that number belonged to for more than two decades. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: PM set to warn China and US the Indo-Pacific not their 'chessboard'
item.description: In a major foreign policy speech set to be delivered in New York, Anthony Albanese will declare the post-1945 world order "is no longer fit for purpose" and warn China and the US the Indo-Pacific is not a "chessboard". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: ‘My friend’: Anthony Albanese announces $60m more for Ukraine at Zelenskyy meeting
item.description: An emotional prime minister says that Kyiv’s cause is ‘an issue for the world’ as he also sets out the need for a new global order Anthony Albanese has announced Australia will provide $60m more in support for Ukraine’s fight against Russia’s invasion during an emotional meeting with Volodymyr ⁠Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the UN meeting in New York. With the prime minister planning to use a key speech in New York to warn that the international world order was “no longer fit for purpose”, he hugged the Ukrainian president as the latyter thanked Australia for its support. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Pearce ready to carve place in AFL history with Freo
item.description: Tasmanian footballer Alex Pearce can create history on Saturday by becoming the Fremantle Football Club's first-ever AFL premiership captain. Pearce was born and raised on Tasmania's north-west coast, where resilience is bred, and sport reigns supreme. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
